notes:
Account background: MicroArc runs a customer-facing realtime analytics API used by two marketplace customers and several mid-market SaaS vendors. Looking to replace a brittle in-house Triton + custom batching layer with a managed inference platform that can guarantee lower unit costs and predictable p95/p99 latency during peaks.

Discovery summary:
- Primary workload: chat-based agent for merchants (short prompts, context windows ~512 tokens), plus reranking of candidate recommendations and vector embeddings for semantic search.
- Targets: p95 latency <= 55ms for chat single-turn (under typical 32 token generation), p99 <= 140ms; baseline throughput target 350-450 rps sustained during flash events.
- Cost sensitivity: seeking token unit economics improvement of ~25% vs current infra; negotiating ARR tied to realized cost-per-1M-tokens.

Technical constraints / preferences:
- MUST: VPC deployment option and KMS/HSM integration for key management (enterprise compliance). On-prem option preferred for regulated customers.
- Model preferences: open models acceptable; favor optimizations for Llama-derivative family or GGML-compatible models. Interested in Redwood suggested model variants with quantization profiles.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to smaller model variant during capacity shortages and deterministic routing by region and SLA tier.

Optimize interest (explicit asks): batching/caching/quantization + bench requests
- Batching: want dynamic batching up to 64 requests with latency-aware thresholds; need config recommendations per workload distribution.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (60s TTL suggested), and cross-request embedding cache to reduce rerank cost.
- Quantization: evaluate 8-bit -> 4-bit quantization tradeoffs; prefer Redwood-run perf tests that include quality regression metrics on our eval set.
- Perf benchmarking: asked Redwood for a side-by-side benchmark vs our in-house setup (Triton w/ int8) across 3 scenarios: 1) low-latency chat (short seq), 2) high-throughput embedding pipeline, 3) rerank micro-batches. Need token-accurate cost estimates.

Sales/eng interactions to date:
- 2026-02-22: Intro call (owner Diana + SE Marcus) - CTO stressed: "we cannot exceed 70ms p99 for checkout assistance" - Fireflies FF-20260222-1843-9A7B.
- 2026-02-28: Deep-dive w/ infra team; Marcus captured perf histograms and internal trace samples. Asked Redwood to provide perf harness.
- 2026-03-05: Security kickoff (SLA/KMS/residency) - legal flagged data residency clause. Linked security deck in Drive.
- 2026-03-09: Demo of Redwood Console and Optimize suggestions; MicroArc liked batch tuning UI but asked for live benchmarking.

POC ask / success criteria:
- Redwood to run benchmark on MicroArc staging dataset (2k representative chat requests + 1k embedding queries + 500 rerank micro-batches).
- Target: 25% lower token cost or equivalent latency-cost tradeoff; no more than 10% quality delta on rerank/embedding recall.
- Deliverables: perf report (latency percentiles, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens), recommended batching/cache/quant profiles, and a test harness jmx/perf script.

Open items / risks:
- Legal needs explicit data residency language before we can enable Private (on-prem) trial.
- Internal infra freeze week (2026-03-15..18) limits available windows for benchmark runs.

Rep notes: next action = schedule perf window 2026-03-20 and provision Redwood Dedicated staging nodes; SE to upload eval set and dashboard expected 3 business days after run.

Quoted customer snippet: "If you can hit the latency + cost numbers in your perf pack we'll move to a Dedicated contract for our top-tier merchants"
